hero.cta_login: Already saved a character? Sign in

intro.texto: Ecuador's popular festivals are far more than celebrations. They are a universe of characters that synthesize centuries of Andean worldview, colonial faith, and mestizo creativity. We document them with the rigor they deserve.

ritual.texto: Popular festivals are the heart of Ecuadorian culture. Throughout the year, the streets fill with characters who dance between the sacred and the festive, carrying centuries of Andean identity in every costume, every mask.

proyecto.texto: Nunna documents the characters of Ecuador's traditional festivals. Learn why this project exists.

personajes.descripcion: Each character carries centuries of history, symbolism, and cultural transformation.
personajes.sin_resultados: No characters found with that criteria.

pases.descripcion: The pases are the stage where the characters come to life.
pases.intro_oficial: Official routes of the Pases del Niño in Riobamba. Each institution organizes its own parade with characters, music and troupes through the streets of the historic center.
pases.dia_banner: Wednesday December 20 · {count} parades throughout the day
pases.nota: Official routes issued by Riobamba City Hall for December 20. Routes and times may vary in future editions.
pases.contenido_pendiente: The full story and photos for this pase are on their way.
pases.intro_nacional: Every province of Ecuador keeps its own celebrations. Explore the map and follow each pase, street by street.

mapa.intro: Tap a province to walk through its pases.
mapa.provincias_con_pases: {count, plural, =1 {# province with pases} other {# provinces with pases}}

recorrido.finale_texto: Each character played their part along the way. And this is just one of Ecuador's many festivals.
